name: Faerie Fire
description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or also be outlined in light for the duration. Outlined creatures do not benefit from the invisible condition. Attack rolls against an outlined creature have advantage.
effect: Outlines creatures in colored light on failed DEX save; attack rolls against outlined creatures have advantage and they cannot benefit from invisibility.
notes: In combat: every enemy within 10 ft of the target (a 20-foot cube's worth) makes its own Dexterity save; each that fails is outlined: every attack against it has advantage, weapon or spell. Concentration, 10 rounds.
